key.server: The remote NTP server's address or reference (IP or hostname)
key.refid: Reference ID of the server that the remote peer is synchronized to. This may be another server or a hardware device.
key.stratum: Distance from the top of the time hierarchy (16 = unsynchronized, 1 = hardware device that provides true time)
key.when: How many seconds ago the last NTP packet was received from this peer
key.poll: Poll interval (in seconds) between requests to this peer. Typically increases automatically
key.reach: An octal value showing an 8-bit shift register of the last 8 reachability checks
key.delay: Round-trip delay (in milliseconds) to the server. Lower is better
key.offset: The time difference between your system clock and the server clock (in milliseconds)
key.jitter: The variation in offset over time (in milliseconds). Lower means a more stable connection

*.descr: The current system peer your machine is syncing time from

+.descr: Candidates that could be used if the primary fails

o.descr: Peer synchronized to a Pulse Per Second signal

#.descr: A source that is selected as a "backup" in the pool

..descr: Peer was considered, but rejected by the intersection algorithm

x.descr: The peer is deemed to be delivering incorrect time, this peer is ignored

-.descr: Peer responded, but statistically out of sync with the main cluster

__pool.descr: A DNS pool as configured in Network Time: General, contains a rotation of NTP servers providing time.

connection_type.s: Symmetric Active, this machine and the peer can provide time to each other
connection_type.p: This peer was discovered via an NTP pool association
